# Jonathan H. Woolson

> Jonathan H. Woolson is a web developer and enterprise CMS consultant based in Fredonia, NY, with 20+ years building and managing enterprise-scale Drupal websites, optimizing SEO/GEO, and sustaining WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and QA standards. He helps universities, nonprofits, and businesses build reliable, accessible websites, and helps their teams keep those sites running.

jwoolson.com is a single-page professional profile and résumé. Key facts:

- University Web Manager at SUNY Fredonia, November 2006 – March 2025. Moved fredonia.edu from static HTML to Drupal and managed 16K+ pages for 178 departments (3.3M annual page views). Kept the broken-link rate at 0.001% across 1.8M links, preserved 18,000+ redirects through site migrations, and trained 240+ campus web editors.
- Wrote custom Drupal modules that extend schema_metatag with JSON-LD for EducationalCredentialAwarded and EducationalOccupationalProgram.
- Current consulting work: Jacques Marchais Museum of Tibetan Art (2026–present) and Museum of Reclaimed Urban Space (MoRUS) Omeka/Dublin Core archive (2025–present).
- Past consulting work: Aaron Gies NY-23 congressional campaign website (2025–2026).
- Earlier career: freelance web and design work as 10xDesign (2000–2022), Peachpit Press book design, StorageTek, Macworld magazine, and Quark Software.
- Core skills: Drupal 4–11, PHP, JavaScript, JSON-LD/Schema.org, WCAG 2.2 AA, Siteimprove, GA4/GTM/GSC, Git, DDEV/Lando, and agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, MCP).
- Education: BFA, Alfred University, School of Art and Design (NYSCC), 1991.
- Contact: contact@jwoolson.com

## Projects

- [ArxLibrys](https://arxlibrys.com): Software company building ArxLibrys Arxv, a local-first project memory layer for macOS
- [Listening Pictures](https://listening.pictures): Short documentary films about ecology, recovery, and balance, filmed around Fredonia and the Lake Erie shore

## Research & Publications

- [GenAI Impact on Higher Ed Web Marketing (2025)](https://www.academia.edu/146209350/GenAI_Impact_on_Higher_Ed_Web_Marketing): Research paper on generative AI, search evolution, and GEO for institutional marketing
- [Building a Homegrown University Portal with a Tiny Team (2023)](https://www.academia.edu/175462398/Building_a_Homegrown_University_Portal_with_a_Tiny_Team_by_SUNY_Fredonia_Web_Team_2023): HighEdWeb 2023 talk with Andrea Wasiura on building my.fredonia.edu in Drupal
- [Web Research Report (2009)](https://www.academia.edu/2635779/Web_Research_Report): SUNY Fredonia web CMS requirements study; its ECM model is cited in a University of Porto master's dissertation (Casais, 2010)
- [Academia.edu profile](https://fredonia.academia.edu/jwoolson): All papers, reports, and presentations
